description: Public, read-only access to the open CC0 Yourself to Science catalogue of clinical trials, biobanks, registries, and data or sample donation opportunities.
instructions: No registration or authentication is required. Use search_resources first for faceted discovery, then get_resource for a complete record. The search and fetch tools provide citation-oriented retrieval.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.title: Search research-participation opportunities
tools.description: Search the live catalogue by free text, data type, country, compensation, organization category, or macro category.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.title: Get full resource detail
tools.description: Return the complete record for one catalogue resource by ID or slug.

tools.name: list_data_types
tools.title: List data types
tools.description: List distinct catalogue data types and counts.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.title: List countries
tools.description: List represented availability countries and counts.

tools.name: list_macro_categories
tools.title: List macro categories
tools.description: List top-level catalogue groupings and counts.

tools.name: list_compensation_types
tools.title: List compensation types
tools.description: List donation, payment, and mixed compensation counts.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List organizations represented in the catalogue and counts.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Citation-oriented search
tools.description: Search the catalogue and return document identifiers, titles, and URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Citation-oriented fetch
tools.description: Fetch one catalogue record as text and metadata for citation.
